REPORT.description: PSC AASHTO-LRFD24 Design Report (REPORT). Fields come from the PSC_EXCEL_REQUEST DTO and control where the generated Excel report file is written; all fields are optional and defaults are applied internally, so an empty body is valid.

EXPORT_PATH.description: Export directory path (e.g. C:\Report\). Empty = project file directory.

OUTPUT_NAME.description: Output file name without extension. Empty = project file name.

SAVE_IMAGE_OPTION.description: Save image option (Rating Report only). Design Report ignores this field.
